doc: HireSight Premium Executive Intelligence Report focuses on recruitment performance analysis across engineering, product, sales, and support teams.
q: What is the main subject of the report?
a: The report analyzes recruitment performance across multiple teams.

doc: Average time-to-hire dropped from forty-two days to thirty-four days after process changes.
q: How did time-to-hire change after process improvements?
a: It improved from 42 days to 34 days.

doc: Referral-based hires outperformed sourced candidates in retention during the first six months.
q: Which candidate source performed better in early retention?
a: Referral-based hires performed better in six-month retention.

doc: The most common bottleneck was interviewer availability, especially for cross-functional panel rounds.
q: What was the main bottleneck in the hiring process?
a: Interviewer availability was the biggest bottleneck.

doc: Recommendations include standardizing scorecards, enforcing turnaround targets, and refreshing role descriptions.
q: What recommendations are provided to improve recruitment outcomes?
a: Standardize scorecards, enforce interview turnaround targets, and refresh role descriptions.
